title: Framer theme
description: A pure-black site-builder theme: #000 page, surfaces only a few steps up (#111 panels, #171717 media wells, #1a1a1a quiet buttons and hairlines), white headings and 60%-white body copy, white primary buttons with black text, and one bright blue used sparingly. Outfit geometric headings tracked tight over Inter body text; 8px buttons, 20px cards. A clean white sibling.
notes: dark is the faithful mode (preview with mode=dark); light is a white sibling in the same spirit
Outfit stands in for GT Walsheim (closed): geometric with single-storey a and g; Inter is the original's body face
--section-y is the desktop padding (7.5rem); blocks use 3.75rem on phones
--radius is the 8px button corner; cards use 2.5× it (20px), media wells 2× (16px)
